description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMongoEventAdapter' that implements the 'EventAdapter' interface for converting 'Event' objects to and from JSON representations suitable for MongoDB persistence. It includes methods for manifest identification, serialization to journal format, deserialization from journal format, and internal parsing with error handling, tailored for events within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AbstractMongoEventAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class that provides the serialization and deserialization logic for 'Event' objects to be stored in MongoDB, including error handling and JSON schema management.

methods.name: manifest
methods.description: Returns the type of the event as a string, used as a manifest identifier during persistence.

methods.name: toJournal
methods.description: Converts an 'Event' object into a JSON representation suitable for MongoDB storage.

methods.name: fromJournal
methods.description: Reconstructs an 'Event' object from its stored JSON form in the journal.

methods.name: tryParseEvent
methods.description: Attempts to parse a JSON value into an 'Event', with error logging and fallback to null.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Performs the actual parsing of a JSON value into an 'Event', applying schema revisions.
